<details class="rwv-analysis-details">
<summary>Analysis steps, methods and full verification</summary>

## Tasks

This step draws the final Supplementary Figure 3 layout in R/grid from verified NARP tables and registered display materials: definition membership, seven-sample carrier abundance, local gene neighbourhoods and ORF102 domain/structural evidence. The full-model and local-overlay PNGs are reused pixel-identically; no structure prediction or structural alignment is rerun. Supplementary Note 1 retains depth/reference checks and host background in Tables A-C. Tasks 2-5 validate the component evidence; Task 6 assembles the current figure.

### Task 1: Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
# 2026-10-17: the adopted v35 NARP figure (Supplementary Figure 3) is a registered raw input of this step.
raw_manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "raw-input-manifest.tsv"))
raw_path <- function(f) rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, f, raw_manifest)
style <- rwv_style_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/style.yml", manifest))
style <- rwv_style_for_figure(style, "sfig3")   # v40: figure-specific text sizes (config/style.yml figure_text_pt)
palettes <- rwv_palettes_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/palettes.yml", manifest))
figures <- rwv_figures_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/figures.yml", manifest))
defs <- rwv_definitions_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/definitions.tsv", manifest))
# Sample order, the Figure 3a short display names (Data 1 S51) and the 030 sample-abundance table are used by the
# data checks below; Task 6 assembles the current Supplementary Figure 3 in R/grid from registered display materials.
samples <- rwv_samples_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", manifest), style)
ko_labels <- as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_project_input(step, "config/f3-ko-labels.tsv", manifest)))
up3 <- function(f) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "030-function-inputs", f)))
disp <- up3("f3_display.tsv")
cab <- up3("narp_carrier_sample_abundance.tsv")   # 49 rows written by 030 from the 012 TSE
ch <- up3("f3_carrier_hosts.tsv")
narp <- up3("narp_definitions.tsv")
dfg <- up3("votu0052_defensefinder.tsv")
ev <- up3("narp_case_evidence.tsv"); ev$value <- as.numeric(ev$value)
pairs <- up3("narp_gene_pairs.tsv")
gaps <- up3("function-gaps.tsv")
fonts <- rwv_fonts_resolve(style, italic = TRUE)   # gene symbols in panel a are italic
spec <- rwv_figure_spec(figures, "sfig3", params$name)
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
pt <- style$text_pt; ink <- style$colours$text; fam <- style$font$family
lvl <- rwv_sample_levels(samples)
site_col <- rwv_site_colours(style)
```

### Task 2: Validate display-KO carriers and host evidence

Use only the 200 verified iPHoP score >= 90 records from 020. Historical host fields in the driver table are excluded. Dataset-level genus visibility is distinct from same-sample co-detection and infection evidence.

```{r}
#| label: panel-a
st_lab <- c(named_genus_detected_in_16s = "named genus in 16S", named_genus_not_detected_in_16s = "named genus not in 16S",
            genus_unresolved = "genus unresolved")
st_col <- unlist(palettes$host_status)[names(st_lab)]
row_lab <- disp$KO   # KO stays the row key; the axis shows the Figure 3a short names
lab_map <- ko_labels[match(disp$KO, ko_labels$KO), ]
rwv_check(checks, "label table covers the 11 displayed KOs, one row each", sort(disp$KO), sort(ko_labels$KO), source = "config/f3-ko-labels.tsv")
ko_short <- setNames(lab_map$short_label, disp$KO)
ko_italic <- setNames(toupper(lab_map$italic) == "TRUE", disp$KO)
ko_axis_labels <- function(breaks) do.call(expression, lapply(breaks, function(b)
  if (isTRUE(ko_italic[[b]])) bquote(italic(.(ko_short[[b]]))) else ko_short[[b]]))
ch$row <- factor(row_lab[match(ch$feature_id, disp$KO)], levels = rev(row_lab))
rwv_check(checks, "carriers per displayed KO equal Figure 3", as.numeric(disp$n_carriers),
          as.numeric(table(ch$row)[row_lab]), source = "f3_display.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "host statuses are the three record classes or no record", TRUE,
          all(ch$iphop90_status %in% c(names(st_lab), "no iPHoP >= 90 record")))
# Bars count only carriers with an iPHoP >= 90 record; the number at the right
# is carriers with a record/all carriers of that KO.
rec <- ch[ch$iphop90_status %in% names(st_lab), ]
rec$status <- factor(rec$iphop90_status, levels = rev(names(st_lab)))
cnt <- as.data.frame(table(row = rec$row, status = rec$status))
n_all <- as.integer(table(ch$row)[levels(ch$row)])
with_rec <- as.integer(table(rec$row)[levels(ch$row)])
rwv_check(checks, "carriers with an iPHoP >= 90 record (all displayed KOs)", 23, sum(with_rec),
          source = "regression constant (17 + 5 + 1 in f3_carrier_hosts.tsv)")
lab <- data.frame(row = factor(levels(ch$row), levels = levels(ch$row)), txt = rwv_fmt_frac(with_rec, n_all))
x_max <- 15
rwv_check(checks, "largest record count fits the axis", TRUE, max(with_rec) <= x_max)
```

### Task 3: Validate membership under four NARP definitions

```{r}
#| label: panel-b
defs_cols <- c(df_narp1 = "NARP1", df_narp2 = "NARP2", ko_K03462_K13522 = "KO rule", dbapis_narp_targeting = "dbAPIS")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp1_df", sum(narp$df_narp1 == "1"), "narp_definitions.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp2_df", sum(narp$df_narp2 == "1"), "narp_definitions.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp_ko_cooccurrence", sum(narp$ko_K03462_K13522 == "1"), "narp_definitions.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "dbapis_narp_targeting", sum(narp$dbapis_narp_targeting == "1"), "narp_definitions.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "every row belongs to at least one definition", TRUE,
          all(rowSums(sapply(names(defs_cols), function(k) narp[[k]] == "1")) >= 1))
# Candidate: the five DefenseFinder NARP2 calls first (vOTU0052 on top), then the rest by vOTU id.
b_order <- c("vOTU0052", setdiff(narp$vOTU_id[narp$df_narp2 == "1"], "vOTU0052"), narp$vOTU_id[narp$df_narp2 != "1"])
rwv_check(checks, "NARP definition table keeps all 19 NARP-related vOTUs (S3a)", 19L, length(unique(b_order)))
narp <- narp[match(b_order, narp$vOTU_id), ]
n_b2 <- sum(narp$df_narp2 == "1")
q_short <- c(Complete = "C", `High-quality` = "HQ", `Medium-quality` = "MQ", `Low-quality` = "LQ")
rwv_check(checks, "CheckV classes have a short mark", TRUE, all(narp$checkv_quality %in% names(q_short)))
tiles <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(defs_cols), function(k) {
  data.frame(vOTU_id = narp$vOTU_id, def = defs_cols[[k]], member = narp[[k]] == "1")
}))
tiles$vOTU_id <- factor(tiles$vOTU_id, levels = rev(narp$vOTU_id))
tiles$def <- factor(tiles$def, levels = defs_cols)
q_lab <- data.frame(vOTU_id = factor(narp$vOTU_id, levels = rev(narp$vOTU_id)),
                    txt = sprintf("%s %s%%", q_short[narp$checkv_quality], formatC(as.numeric(narp$checkv_completeness_pct), format = "f", digits = 1)))
tot <- data.frame(def = factor(defs_cols, levels = defs_cols),
                  n = sapply(names(defs_cols), function(k) sum(narp[[k]] == "1")))
```

### Task 4: Validate case abundance and ORF102 domains

ORF102 domain boundaries are hmmscan predictions. Conserved residues do not establish cleavage activity. atd1 (ORF166) is a separate call about 45 kb from ORF101-ORF103.

```{r}
#| label: panel-c
dfg$orf <- sub("^vctg2997-cat_1_", "ORF", dfg$hit_id)
rwv_check(checks, "DefenseFinder hits on vOTU0052 (Data 1 S27; legend claim)", c("ORF101", "ORF103", "ORF166"), dfg$orf)
rwv_check(checks, "ORF101/ORF103 are the NARP2 profiles", c("narp2_nmnat", "narp2_nampt"), dfg$gene_name[dfg$orf != "ORF166"])
# (C) Where the NARP2 case set occurs. Abundance is the masked trimmed TPM of the 012 TSE divided by
# 10,000 (computed in 030), i.e. percent of the whole breadth-masked catalogue in each sample
# (the unit of Fig. 4a); one shared colour scale, no row scaling; a dash marks a vOTU below the 75%
# breadth threshold in that sample (masked to zero), which is not absence from the water.
n2 <- narp$vOTU_id[narp$df_narp2 == "1"]
k13522_carriers <- sort(unique(ch$vOTU_id[ch$feature_id == "K13522"]))
extra <- setdiff(k13522_carriers, n2)
rwv_check(checks, "the five DefenseFinder NARP2 calls all carry K13522", TRUE, all(n2 %in% k13522_carriers))
rwv_check(checks, "nadM (K13522) carriers without a DefenseFinder NARP2 call", c("vOTU0863", "vOTU1898"), extra,
          source = "f3_carrier_hosts.tsv; narp_definitions.tsv")
c_rows <- c("vOTU0052", setdiff(n2, "vOTU0052"), extra)
cab$catalogue_percent <- as.numeric(cab$catalogue_percent); cab$trimmed_tpm_masked <- as.numeric(cab$trimmed_tpm_masked)
cab$detected <- toupper(cab$detected) == "TRUE"
rwv_check(checks, "sample table holds the case set in panel order", c_rows, unique(cab$vOTU_id), source = "030/narp_carrier_sample_abundance.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "sample table: every vOTU x configured sample once", 49L, nrow(unique(merge(cab[, c("vOTU_id", "sample_id")],
          expand.grid(vOTU_id = c_rows, sample_id = lvl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))))
rwv_check(checks, "percent equals masked trimmed TPM / 10,000", cab$trimmed_tpm_masked / 1e4, cab$catalogue_percent, tol = 1e-12)
rwv_check(checks, "non-zero cells are exactly the detected vOTU-sample pairs (covered fraction >= 0.75; checked in 030)", TRUE,
          identical(cab$catalogue_percent > 0, cab$detected))
heat_c <- data.frame(vOTU_id = cab$vOTU_id, sample_id = cab$sample_id, pct = cab$catalogue_percent)
heat_c$txt <- ifelse(heat_c$pct > 0, trimws(formatC(heat_c$pct, format = "fg", digits = 2)), rwv_ndash)
heat_c$fillv <- ifelse(heat_c$pct > 0, heat_c$pct, NA)
c_lim <- c(0.02, 4)
rwv_check(checks, "non-zero abundances fall inside the colour limits", TRUE, all(heat_c$pct[heat_c$pct > 0] >= c_lim[1] & heat_c$pct[heat_c$pct > 0] <= c_lim[2]))
# 2026-10-14 adoption (reviewed candidate A): one 7 x 7 matrix instead of two stacked blocks
# and a site strip. The five DefenseFinder NARP2 calls sit above the dashed line and the two
# other nadM carriers below it; completeness is shown once, in b. Same 49 values, colour
# limits, log scale, sample order and dash rule as before.
c_y <- setNames(c(8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 2, 1), c_rows)
heat_c$row_y <- unname(c_y[heat_c$vOTU_id])
heat_c$sample_id <- factor(heat_c$sample_id, levels = lvl)
rwv_check(checks, "carrier abundance: 8 detected cells and 41 dashes (S3b)", c(8L, 41L), c(sum(heat_c$pct > 0), sum(heat_c$pct == 0)),
          source = "030/narp_carrier_sample_abundance.tsv")
```

```{r}
#| label: panel-d
dom <- setNames(ev$value[ev$group == "orf102_domains"], ev$item[ev$group == "orf102_domains"])
len <- dom[["ORF102 length"]]
rwv_check(checks, "ORF102 length (aa)", 211, len, source = "narp_case_evidence.tsv; 030 anchors it to the gene coordinates")
rwv_check(checks, "GIY-YIG and NUMOD-like boundaries", c(3, 87, 153, 184, 143, 188),
          unname(dom[c("GIY-YIG catalytic domain start", "GIY-YIG catalytic domain end",
                       "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain start", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain end",
                       "NUMOD-like envelope start", "NUMOD-like envelope end")]),
          source = "document transcription (doc_votu0052_orf102.md line 138); no independent source")
# 2026-10-14 adoption: a one-dimensional sequence-domain track. Two equal-height segments show the
# GIY-YIG (3-87) and I-HmuI NUMOD-like (153-184) matches; rectangle height has no meaning. The
# envelope (143-188) stays in the legend, Supplementary Note 1 and Data 1 S28, not drawn as a third box.
domain_track <- data.frame(
  start = unname(dom[c("GIY-YIG catalytic domain start", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain start")]),
  end = unname(dom[c("GIY-YIG catalytic domain end", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain end")]),
  name = c("GIY-YIG", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like"))
domain_track$label <- paste0(domain_track$name, "\n", rwv_fmt_range(domain_track$start, domain_track$end))
d_axis <- sprintf("ORF102 protein position (aa; %d aa total)", as.integer(len))
rwv_check(checks, "ORF102 domain matches (envelope excluded)", c(3, 87, 153, 184),
          c(rbind(domain_track$start, domain_track$end)))
```

### Task 5: Retain depth/reference checks in Supplementary Note 1

```{r}
#| label: note-evidence
cov <- ev[ev$group == "coverage", ]
he <- ev[ev$group == "he_targeting", ]
gl <- ev[ev$group == "global_narp", ]
rwv_check(checks, "vOTU0052 locus relative depth", 1.00, cov$value[grepl("vctg2997", cov$item)],
          source = "document transcription (doc_votu0052_coverage_spike.md line 63); no independent source")
rwv_check(checks, "coverage rows (vOTU0052 + 4 comparison loci)", 5, nrow(cov))
rwv_check(checks, "strict-site observed versus expected", c(0, 0.45),
          he$value[match(c("strict site (between the two genes): observed", "strict site: expected"), he$item)],
          source = "document transcription (doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md line 66); no independent source")
he_val <- function(item) { v <- he$value[he$item == item]; if (length(v) != 1L) rwv_fail("Missing HE item: ", item); v }
he_p <- c(he_val("strict site: reported one-sided Poisson enrichment p"), he_val("+-10 ORF window: reported one-sided Poisson enrichment p"))
he_cohort <- c(he_val("reference cohort: NAMPT-positive INPHARED genomes"), he_val("reference cohort: genomes with NMNAT near NAMPT (NARP2 module)"))
# The sample of each contig is the third cell of its source table row.
cov_sample <- vapply(strsplit(cov$source_text, "|", fixed = TRUE), function(z) trimws(gsub("\\*", "", z[4])), "")
rwv_check(checks, "coverage samples parsed from the source rows (gd1v, od1v, gc1v, gd1v, gd1v)",
          c("gd1v", "od1v", "gc1v", "gd1v", "gd1v"), cov_sample, source = "doc_votu0052_coverage_spike.md lines 63-67")
cov_tab <- sort(table(cov_sample), decreasing = TRUE)
rwv_check(checks, "reported Poisson p (strict, +-10 ORF)", c(1, 0.79), he_p, source = "document transcription (doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md lines 66, 69)")
rwv_check(checks, "HE reference cohort (NAMPT-positive, NARP2)", c(1369, 104), he_cohort, source = "document transcription (lines 25, 27)")
# Gene spacing (2026-10-11 addition, notes and legend only; the panels are unchanged):
# ORFs between NMNAT and NAMPT in the 104 reference modules (document-reported)
# and in the five local DefenseFinder NARP2 calls (counted from saved gene positions).
he_dist <- c(he_val("NARP2 modules with no ORF between the two genes"), he_val("NARP2 modules with 1 ORF between the two genes"),
             he_val("NARP2 modules with 2-4 ORFs between the two genes"), he_val("NARP2 modules with 6-9 ORFs between the two genes"))
# Historical power label: the case document and S28 call this scenario "odds ratio of 3", but the
# original analysis script sets lam1 = lam0 * 3, a threefold Poisson expected count. The S28 item
# text is kept verbatim (it is a transcription); every text written here uses the corrected term.
he_power <- he_val("strict window: reported power to detect an odds ratio of 3 with 56 assessable genomes")
rwv_check(checks, "reference ORFs between the two genes: none, 1, 2-4, 6-9", c(48, 42, 5, 9), he_dist,
          source = "document transcription (doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md lines 75-76); no independent source")
rwv_check(checks, "references with >= 1 ORF between the genes equal the strict-window assessable genomes", 56, sum(he_dist[-1]))
rwv_check(checks, "historical reported strict-window power (percent; source label odds ratio 3, scenario = threefold Poisson mean)", 16, he_power,
          source = "document transcription (doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md line 62)")
n2_ids <- narp$vOTU_id[narp$df_narp2 == "1"]
loc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(n2_ids, function(v) {
  g <- pairs[pairs$vOTU_id == v, ]
  data.frame(vOTU_id = v, n_genes = nrow(g), between = diff(range(as.numeric(g$gene_position)))  - 1,
             start = min(as.numeric(g$start_position)), end = max(as.numeric(g$end_position)),
             length_bp = as.numeric(narp$length_bp[narp$vOTU_id == v]), quality = narp$checkv_quality[narp$vOTU_id == v],
             completeness = as.numeric(narp$checkv_completeness_pct[narp$vOTU_id == v]))
}))
rwv_check(checks, "each local NARP2 call has one NMNAT and one NAMPT row", rep(2, 5), loc$n_genes, source = "narp_gene_pairs.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "local ORFs between the two genes (vOTU0052, 0113, 0131, 0544, 1643)",
          c(vOTU0052 = 1, vOTU0113 = 1, vOTU0131 = 4, vOTU0544 = 0, vOTU1643 = 0), setNames(loc$between, loc$vOTU_id), source = "narp_gene_pairs.tsv gene positions")
loc$edge <- loc$start <= 100 | loc$end >= loc$length_bp - 100
rwv_check(checks, "only the vOTU1643 locus lies within 100 bp of a contig end", "vOTU1643", loc$vOTU_id[loc$edge])
low <- loc[loc$quality == "Low-quality", ]
rwv_check(checks, "four of the five local NARP2 calls are on Low-quality sequences", 4, nrow(low), source = "narp_definitions.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "global NARP1 / NARP2 module calls", c(566, 166), gl$value, source = "definitions.tsv global_narp = 566/166")

# (Table A of Supplementary Note 1) Relative depth of the NARP2 locus in vOTU0052 and in four other NARP2-carrying contigs.
cov$contig <- sub(" .*", "", cov$item)
cov$kind <- sub("^[^(]*\\(?", "", sub("\\)$", "", cov$item))
cov$votu <- pairs$vOTU_id[match(cov$contig, pairs$vcontig_id)]
rwv_check(checks, "every coverage contig maps to a vOTU through the gene-pair table", FALSE, anyNA(cov$votu), source = "narp_gene_pairs.tsv")
cov$kind <- ifelse(cov$contig == "vctg2997", "GIY-YIG insertion", cov$kind)
rwv_check(checks, "coverage labels resolved", FALSE, any(cov$kind == ""))
cov$focal <- cov$contig == "vctg2997"
# (Table B of Supplementary Note 1) The two reference windows; values transcribed from the case documentation.
win <- data.frame(
  window = c("Strictly between the two member genes", "Within ±10 ORFs of the module"),
  assessable = c(he$value[he$item == "strict site (between the two genes): assessable genomes"],
                 he$value[he$item == "+-10 ORF window: assessable genomes"]),
  observed = c(he$value[he$item == "strict site (between the two genes): observed"], he$value[he$item == "+-10 ORF window: observed"]),
  expected = c(he$value[he$item == "strict site: expected"], he$value[he$item == "+-10 ORF window: expected"]),
  p = he_p)
rwv_check(checks, "HE windows: assessable, observed, expected", c(56, 104, 0, 7, 0.45, 9),
          c(win$assessable, win$observed, win$expected), source = "document transcription (lines 66, 69); no independent source")
```

### Task 6: Draw final Supplementary Figure 3 in R/grid

The final figure is assembled as an R/grid object below and exported using the shared figure exporter. Registered neighbourhood coordinates, colour ramps and two stored structure renders are read from analyses/data/00-raw/d220-sfig2-function-context/. The renders must be embedded pixel-identically. Historical v35 figure files remain provenance/check inputs and are not copied as the final figure. The optional Python/PyMuPDF/PyMOL scripts in supplementary-figure-3 rebuild historical materials only. No structure prediction or overlay calculation is rerun. Host background is retained in Supplementary Note 1 Table C and Data 1 S22.

```{r}
#| label: adopted-figure
adopted <- c(pdf = "narp-v35-figure.pdf", svg = "narp-v35-figure.svg", png = "narp-v35-figure.png", tiff = "narp-v35-figure.tiff")
src <- vapply(adopted, raw_path, "")
av <- as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(raw_path("narp-v35-plot-values.tsv"))); av$value <- as.numeric(av$value)
arec <- jsonlite::read_json(raw_path("narp-v35-export.json"))
rwv_check(checks, "adopted figure assembly checks all passed (build_s2.py record)", TRUE, all(vapply(arec$qa, function(q) isTRUE(q$pass), logical(1))))
# a: membership under the four definitions equals 030 narp_definitions.tsv
am <- av[av$panel == "A", ]
def_col <- c(NARP1 = "df_narp1", NARP2 = "df_narp2", `KO rule` = "ko_K03462_K13522", dbAPIS = "dbapis_narp_targeting")
key <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(def_col), function(d) data.frame(item = paste(narp$vOTU_id, d), value = as.numeric(narp[[def_col[[d]]]] == "1"))))

# b: the 49 abundance cells equal 030 narp_carrier_sample_abundance.tsv

# c: coordinates of the NARP2 member genes equal 030 narp_gene_pairs.tsv

          c(gk("start_position"), gk("end_position")), source = "030/narp_gene_pairs.tsv")
# d: ORF102 length and domain boundaries equal the case evidence used for Supplementary Note 1
dd <- av[av$panel == "D", ]
d_keys <- c("ORF102 length", "GIY-YIG catalytic domain start", "GIY-YIG catalytic domain end", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain start", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain end")
rwv_check(checks, "S3d ORF102 length and domain boundaries = narp_case_evidence.tsv", unname(dom[d_keys]), dd$value[match(d_keys, dd$item)])
s3 <- setNames(dd$value, dd$item)
# 2026-10-18 (v40): Supplementary Figure 3 is drawn here as layout H (outputs/supp34-literature-redesign-2026-10-18,

rwv_check(checks, "S3c neighbourhood vOTUs are the five DefenseFinder NARP2 calls", sort(n2), sort(unique(nb$vOTU_id)))
nbk <- c(paste(nb$protein_id, "start_position"), paste(nb$protein_id, "end_position"))

            vapply(c_rows[1:5], function(v) sum(nb$vOTU_id == v & nb$ko_id == "K03462"), integer(1))))
rwv_check(checks, "S3b/S3d colour ramps have 256 steps", c(256L, 256L), c(length(ramps$heat), length(ramps$viridis)))
a_ids <- c(c_rows[1:5], narp$vOTU_id[!narp$vOTU_id %in% c_rows[1:5]])

W <- spec$width_mm; H <- spec$height_mm; P <- style$text_pt; K <- style$colours

tx <- function(s, x, y, size = P$annotation, bold = FALSE, just = "left", col = ink, italic = FALSE)
  grid::grid.text(s, unit(x, "mm"), unit(H - y, "mm"), just = just,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = fam, fontsize = size, fontface = if (bold) "bold" else if (italic) "italic" else "plain", col = col))
ln <- function(x, y, xx, yy, col = K$grey_rule, mm = style$line_mm$thin, lty = 1)
  grid::grid.lines(unit(c(x, xx), "mm"), unit(H - c(y, yy), "mm"), gp = grid::gpar(col = col, lwd = rwv_lwd(mm), lty = lty))
bx <- function(x, y, w, h, fill = "white", col = NA, mm = style$line_mm$hairline)
  grid::grid.rect(unit(x, "mm"), unit(H - y, "mm"), unit(w, "mm"), unit(h, "mm"), just = c("left", "top"),
                  gp = grid::gpar(fill = fill, col = col, lwd = rwv_lwd(mm)))
# v50 figure cleanup (2026-10-19, Codex task book docs/figure-cleanup-v49-2026-10-19/00): panel letters only; the four
# explanatory titles and the footnote sentences of a, b and d are not drawn (caption / figure notes / Note 1 carry them);
# grey below-detection tiles replace the 41 dashes of b; completeness shown with one decimal. Values unchanged.
tag <- function(id, y, x = 3) tx(rwv_tag(style, id), x, y, P$tag, TRUE)
heat_fill <- function(v) ramps$heat[1 + floor(255 * pmax(0, pmin(1, (log10(v) - log10(c_lim[1])) / (log10(c_lim[2]) - log10(c_lim[1])))))]
arrow <- function(a, b, y, dir = 1, fill = K$grey_light, col = fill, mm = style$line_mm$hairline, lty = 1) {
  h <- min(1.8, (b - a) * .3)
  x <- if (dir > 0) c(a, b - h, b, b - h, a) else c(b, a + h, a, a + h, b)
  grid::grid.polygon(unit(x, "mm"), unit(H - c(y - 1.6, y - 1.6, y, y + 1.6, y + 1.6), "mm"), gp = grid::gpar(fill = fill, col = col, lwd = rwv_lwd(mm), lty = lty))
}
xr <- c(-1700, 5400)
neighbour <- function(id, x0, x1, y) {
  z <- nb[nb$vOTU_id == id, ]; nm <- z[z$ko_id == "K13522", ]; neg <- nm$strandedness == -1
  anchor <- if (neg) nm$end_position else nm$start_position
  xm <- function(v) x0 + (v - xr[1]) / diff(xr) * (x1 - x0)
  ln(x0, y, x1, y)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(z))) {
    zz <- z[i, ]; aa <- if (neg) anchor - zz$end_position else zz$start_position - anchor; bb <- if (neg) anchor - zz$start_position else zz$end_position - anchor
    member <- zz$ko_id %in% c("K13522", "K03462")
    he <- (id == "vOTU0052" && zz$gene_position == 102) || (id == "vOTU0131" && zz$gene_position %in% c(22, 27))
    arrow(xm(aa), xm(bb), y, zz$strandedness * if (neg) -1 else 1,
          if (member) palettes$gene$narp_member else if (he) "white" else K$grey_light,
          if (he) palettes$he$ink else if (member) palettes$gene$narp_member else "white",
          if (he) style$line_mm$main else style$line_mm$hairline, if (he && id == "vOTU0131") 2 else 1)
    if (member) tx(if (zz$ko_id == "K13522") "NMNAT" else "NAMPT", (xm(aa) + xm(bb)) / 2, y, just = "centre", col = "white")
    if (he) tx(paste0("ORF", zz$gene_position), (xm(aa) + xm(bb)) / 2, y - 3.8, just = "centre")
  }
  if (id == "vOTU1643") { ee <- xm(anchor - 1); ln(ee, y - 2, ee, y + 2, ink, style$line_mm$main); tx("end", ee + 1, y + 3.3) }
}
draw_s3 <- function() {
  # a: membership under the four definitions (all 19 vOTUs), CheckV class and completeness
  tag("A", 6)
  hd <- c("N1", "N2", "KO", "db"); fill4 <- c(palettes$function_calls$narp_call, palettes$function_calls$narp_call,
                                              palettes$function_calls$ko_rule, palettes$function_calls$anti_defense_tool)
  for (j in 1:4) { tx(hd[j], 26 + (j - .5) * 7, 15, just = "centre", bold = TRUE); tx(paste0("(", tot4[j], ")"), 26 + (j - .5) * 7, 19, just = "centre") }
  tx("CheckV / %", 55, 15, bold = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_along(a_ids)) {
    y <- 24 + (i - 1) * 3.8; z <- narp[narp$vOTU_id == a_ids[i], ]
    tx(a_ids[i], 3, y, bold = i == 1)
    for (j in 1:4) bx(26 + (j - 1) * 7, y - 1.5, 6, 3, if (z[[cols4[j]]] == "1") fill4[j] else "white", K$grey_rule)
    tx(paste0(q_short[[z$checkv_quality]], " ", formatC(as.numeric(z$checkv_completeness_pct), format = "f", digits = 1), "%"), 55, y)
    if (i == 5) ln(3, y + 1.9, 87, y + 1.9, K$grey_mid, style$line_mm$thin, 2)
  }
  # b: the 49 abundance cells of the five NARP2 calls and two further nadM carriers
  tag("B", 6, 92)
  for (j in seq_along(lvl)) tx(lvl[j], 112 + (j - .5) * 9.3, 15, just = "centre")
  for (i in seq_along(c_rows)) {
    y <- 24 + (i - 1) * 8; tx(c_rows[i], 92, y, bold = i == 1)
    for (j in seq_along(lvl)) {
      z <- heat_c[heat_c$vOTU_id == c_rows[i] & as.character(heat_c$sample_id) == lvl[j], ]; stopifnot(nrow(z) == 1L)
      bx(112 + (j - 1) * 9.3, y - 2.5, 9.0, 5, if (z$pct > 0) heat_fill(z$pct) else K$grey_rule, K$grey_rule)
      if (z$pct > 0) tx(z$txt, 112 + (j - .5) * 9.3 - .15, y, just = "centre", col = if (z$pct > 0.7) "white" else ink)
    }
    if (i == 5) ln(92, y + 4, 177, y + 4, K$grey_mid, style$line_mm$thin, 2)
  }
  for (k in 1:256) bx(120 + 40 * (k - 1) / 256, 79, 40 / 256 + .03, 1.8, ramps$heat[k])
  for (v in c(.03, .1, .3, 1, 3)) tx(v, 120 + (log10(v) - log10(c_lim[1])) / (log10(c_lim[2]) - log10(c_lim[1])) * 40, 84, just = "centre")
  tx("Whole catalogue (%)", 140, 89, just = "centre")
  bx(120, 93.5, 9.0, 5, K$grey_rule, K$grey_rule); tx("Below detection rule", 131, 96)
  # c: the five saved neighbourhoods at one bp scale, anchored at the NMNAT start
  tag("C", 112)
  for (i in 1:5) { y <- 123 + (i - 1) * 10; tx(paste0(c_rows[i], if (c_rows[i] %in% c("vOTU0131", "vOTU1643")) "\u2020" else ""), 3, y, bold = TRUE); neighbour(c_rows[i], 26, 176, y) }   # \u2020 displayed reversed (caption)
  for (v in seq(-1000, 5000, 1000)) { x <- 26 + (v - xr[1]) / diff(xr) * 150; ln(x, 168, x, 169, K$grey_mid); tx(if (v < 0) paste0(rwv_minus, abs(v)) else v, x, 172.5, just = "centre") }
  tx("bp relative to NMNAT start", 101, 177.5, just = "centre")
  bx(3, 183, 3, 2.4, palettes$gene$narp_member); tx("NARP2 member", 8, 184.2)
  arrow(40, 43.5, 184.2, 1, "white", palettes$he$ink, style$line_mm$main, 1); tx("ORF102: domain candidate", 45.5, 184.2)
  arrow(97, 100.5, 184.2, 1, "white", palettes$he$ink, style$line_mm$main, 2); tx("ORF22/27: VOGdb annotation", 102.5, 184.2)
  bx(152, 183, 3, 2.4, K$grey_light); tx("Other ORF", 157, 184.2)
  # d: domain track, saved full-length prediction and local reference comparison
  tag("D", 193)
  xdom <- function(n) 57 + (n - 1) / (len - 1) * 115
  tx(sprintf("ORF102 (%d aa)", as.integer(len)), 26, 201, bold = TRUE)
  ln(57, 201, 172, 201)
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(domain_track))) {
    d <- domain_track[k, ]; bx(xdom(d$start), 200, xdom(d$end) - xdom(d$start), 2, palettes$he$fill, palettes$he$fill)
    tx(paste0(c("GIY-YIG", "NUMOD-like")[k], " (", rwv_fmt_range(d$start, d$end), ")"), (xdom(d$start) + xdom(d$end)) / 2, 197, just = "centre")
  }
  for (n in c(1, 100, len)) tx(n, xdom(n), 205.5, just = "centre")
  tx(sprintf("Predicted model (%d aa)", as.integer(len)), 44, 211.5, just = "centre"); tx("GIY-YIG reference comparison", 137, 211.5, just = "centre")
  hf <- 32; wf <- hf * ncol(img_full) / nrow(img_full); wo <- hf * ncol(img_ov) / nrow(img_ov)
  grid::grid.raster(img_full, unit(44 - wf / 2, "mm"), unit(H - 214, "mm"), unit(wf, "mm"), unit(hf, "mm"), just = c("left", "top"))
  grid::grid.raster(img_ov, unit(137 - wo / 2, "mm"), unit(H - 214, "mm"), unit(wo, "mm"), unit(hf, "mm"), just = c("left", "top"))
  for (k in 1:100) bx(6 + (k - 1) / 100 * 25, 248.2, 25 / 100 + .02, 1.7, ramps$viridis[1 + round((k - 1) / 99 * 255)])
  tx("0.5", 6, 252.8); tx("1.0", 31, 252.8, just = "right"); tx("pLDDT", 34, 249.2)
  ln(100, 249.2, 104, 249.2, palettes$he$fill, 0.6); tx(paste0("ORF102, ", rwv_fmt_range(dom[["GIY-YIG catalytic domain start"]], dom[["GIY-YIG catalytic domain end"]])), 106, 249.2)
  ln(139, 249.2, 143, 249.2, K$grey_dark, 0.6); tx("I-TevI (1MK0)", 145, 249.2)
}
page <- grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(rwv_capture_grob(draw_s3(), width = rwv_mm_to_in(W), height = rwv_mm_to_in(H), style = style, fonts = fonts)),
                    vp = grid::viewport(width = unit(W, "mm"), height = unit(H, "mm"), clip = "off"))
expected3 <- c(rwv_tag(style, c("A", "B", "C", "D")), a_ids, "CheckV / %", "MQ 88.8%",
               "(3)", "(5)", "(6)", "(19)", lvl, "Whole catalogue (%)", "Below detection rule", "NMNAT", "NAMPT", "ORF102", "ORF22", "ORF27", "end",
               "bp relative to NMNAT start", "NARP2 member", "ORF102: domain candidate", "ORF22/27: VOGdb annotation", "Other ORF",
               "Predicted model (211 aa)", "GIY-YIG reference comparison", "pLDDT", "I-TevI (1MK0)")
rwv_check(checks, "S3b grey below-detection tiles / detected tiles (v50, no dashes)", c(41L, 8L), c(sum(heat_c$pct == 0), sum(heat_c$pct > 0)))
res3 <- rwv_figure_export(patchwork::wrap_elements(full = page), path_target, "sfig3", spec, style, fonts, expected3, step,
                          registered_rasters = list(img_full, img_ov))
knitr::kable(res3$qa[, c("format", "check", "observed", "pass")])
```


### Task 6b: Export Supplementary Note 1 and its complete value table

The formal supplementary-note-1-narp.md (copied by 900 as Supplementary_Note_1_NARP.md) and supplementary-note-1-values.tsv retain 22 entries: five former-panel-E rows, 15 former-panel-F rows and two envelope rows. All values come from 030 tables; prose describes predictions and source transcriptions without a new calculation.

sci <- function(x) {
  m <- sub("e.*$", "", x); e <- as.integer(sub("^.*e", "", x))
  sup <- c("-" = "⁻", "0" = "⁰", "1" = "¹", "2" = "²", "3" = "³", "4" = "⁴",
           "5" = "⁵", "6" = "⁶", "7" = "⁷", "8" = "⁸", "9" = "⁹")
  paste0(m, " × 10", paste(sup[strsplit(as.character(e), "")[[1]]], collapse = ""))
}

  "- The ratio is the median per-base depth across the locus divided by the median per-base depth across its whole contig (sliding windows were used only for position diagnostics in the original analysis). It is not the abundance of the virus in the sample.",
  sprintf("- For vOTU0052 in gd1, the two medians coincide at the reported precision (ratio %s). The four comparison ratios range from %s to %s, and %s of them exceed 1; none is a matched control and no significance test was made.",
          f2(cov$value[cov$focal]), f2(min(cmp_ratio)), f2(max(cmp_ratio)), words(sum(cmp_ratio > 1))),
  "- vOTU0052 is a medium-quality sequence and the four comparison contigs are low-quality, so their recovery contexts differ; no repeated series per contig is available.",
  "- A population-median snapshot cannot exclude local depth peaks, amplification in a minority of genomes or amplification under an unobserved induction condition. A ratio of 1.00 shows neither that the assembly is error-free nor that the locus is inactive.", "",
  "## Table B. HE-domain annotations near reference NARP2 modules (formerly panel f of the NARP figure)", "",
  paste("Question: are homing-endonuclease (HE) domain annotations found more often than expected between, or near, the two member genes of reference NARP2 modules?",
        "This reference check does not involve the local samples and does not test activity."), "",
  sprintf(paste("The reference set is %s NARP2 modules (NMNAT near NAMPT) among %s NAMPT-positive INPHARED phage genomes with uniformly called ORFs.",
                "It is neither the seven local samples nor the %s-genome collection of Fig. 5.",
                "HE domains are Pfam GIY-YIG, HNH, LAGLIDADG and NUMOD families at their gathering thresholds."),
          rwv_fmt_int(he_cohort[2]), rwv_fmt_int(he_cohort[1]), "77,951"), "",
  "| Window | Assessable modules / total | Observed genomes with an HE-domain annotation | Expected under the conditional null | Reported one-sided Poisson enrichment p |",
  "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
  sprintf("| %s | %s/%s | %d | %s | %s |", win$window, rwv_fmt_int(win$assessable), rwv_fmt_int(he_cohort[2]), as.integer(win$observed),
          f2(win$expected), f2(win$p)), "",
  sprintf(paste("- The strict window can be assessed only when at least one ORF lies between the two member genes. In %d of the %d modules the two genes are adjacent and the strict window is empty;",
                "these modules are not failed or unexamined samples. Intervening ORFs: none in %d modules, one in %d, two to four in %d and six to nine in %d, so %d = %d + %d + %d modules are assessable."),
          he_dist[1], sum(he_dist), he_dist[1], he_dist[2], he_dist[3], he_dist[4], sum(he_dist[-1]), he_dist[2], he_dist[3], he_dist[4]),
  sprintf(paste("- In the five local DefenseFinder NARP2 calls, counted from the recorded gene positions, the intervening ORFs number %s.",
                "Four of the five are on low-quality sequences, and the vOTU1643 locus starts at bp %d of its contig, so the spacing between its two genes is observed but the sequence beyond the contig end is not.",
                "One selected local case cannot estimate how often HE-like genes occupy this position."),
          paste(sprintf("%s, %d", loc$vOTU_id, as.integer(loc$between)), collapse = "; "), as.integer(loc$start[loc$vOTU_id == "vOTU1643"])),
  paste("- The expectation sums, over genomes, the probability that at least one HE-domain annotation falls in the window when each genome's own HE-domain count is placed at random among its ORFs",
        "(a null conditional on each genome's HE count and ORF count). Exchangeable positions are a modelling assumption, and shared ancestry among reference phages limits interpretation."),
  sprintf("- The p-values are the one-sided Poisson enrichment values of the original report (%s and %s). They were not recomputed, do not test depletion, and do not establish equality or the absence of an association.",
          f2(win$p[1]), f2(win$p[2])),
  sprintf("- With a strict-window expectation of %s, observing %d gives little basis for excluding a modest enrichment: the strict window has limited sensitivity, although the test is not uninformative about every possible effect.",
          f2(win$expected[1]), as.integer(win$observed[1])),
  sprintf(paste("- The source document reports %d%% power for the strict window and labels that scenario an odds ratio of 3.",
                "The original analysis script defines the scenario as a threefold increase in the Poisson expected count, not as an odds ratio.",
                "The %d%% value is kept only as the historically reported figure; it was not recomputed or independently validated here."),
          as.integer(he_power), as.integer(he_power)),
  "- No record establishes whether the windows were specified before or after the data were examined; they are reported as defined in the original analysis.", "",
  "## Sources", "",
  sprintf("- Data 1 S28: every value in this note with the case document, line and verbatim source text (ORF102 domains: %s; Table A: %s; Table B: %s). The S28 item text of the power row keeps the source label verbatim; its corrected meaning is given above.",
          src_txt("orf102_domains"), src_txt("coverage"), src_txt("he_targeting")),
  "- Data 1 S27: DefenseFinder gene rows of vOTU0052. Data 1 S52: per-sample abundance of the seven carriers in Supplementary Fig. 3b. Local gene spacing: gene positions of the five local NARP2 calls in the DRAM-v annotation table.",
  "- The per-base depth vectors and the per-genome reference tables were not reanalysed for this note; Tables A and B repeat the reported summaries."
)
bad <- rwv_text_violations(paste(note, collapse = " "))
if (length(bad)) rwv_fail("Supplementary Note 1 contains forbidden strings: ", paste(bad, collapse = "; "))
rwv_check(checks, "Supplementary Note 1: Table A rows (vOTU, sample, ratio)", paste(c("vOTU0052", "vOTU0131", "vOTU0113", "vOTU1643", "vOTU0544"),
          c("gd1", "od1", "gc1", "gd1", "gd1"), c("1.00", "1.09", "1.28", "0.91", "1.19")), paste(cov$votu, cov$sample, f2(cov$value)),
          source = "narp_case_evidence.tsv coverage rows; contig to vOTU through narp_gene_pairs.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "Supplementary Note 1: Table B (assessable, observed, expected, p) per window",
          c("56", "0", "0.45", "1.00", "104", "7", "9.00", "0.79"),
          c(rbind(rwv_fmt_int(win$assessable), as.integer(win$observed), f2(win$expected), f2(win$p))))
rwv_check(checks, "Supplementary Note 1 does not call the historical power an odds-ratio calculation", TRUE,
          any(grepl("not as an odds ratio", note, fixed = TRUE)))
# Author-approved candidate-host context derived from the complete register.
host_register <- as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source,
                                      "030-function-inputs", "amg_host_register.tsv")))
h52 <- host_register[host_register$vOTU_id == "vOTU0052", , drop = FALSE]
rwv_check(checks, "NARP case has one retained primary-host register row", 1L, nrow(h52))
rwv_check(checks, "NARP primary host and co-detection agree with the saved endpoints", TRUE,
          sub("^g__", "", h52$host_genus_clean) == "Novosphingobium" &&
          h52$codetected_samples == "gd1" &&
          !toupper(h52$strict_crispr_same_genus) %in% c("TRUE", "1"),
          source = "030/amg_host_register.tsv")
note <- c(note, "", "## Candidate host context", "",
  sprintf(paste("The retained iPHoP prediction for vOTU0052 was *%s* (score %s); the vOTU and predicted host genus",
                "were co-detected in %s. No strict CRISPR record was available for this vOTU and genus.",
                "This is candidate host context, not evidence of infection or of the host's metabolic functions (Data 1 S59)."),
          sub("^g__", "", h52$host_genus_clean), rwv_fmt_num(as.numeric(h52$iphop_confidence), 1), h52$codetected_samples), "",
  sprintf(paste("The complete register retains all %d AMG-export KO carriers, including those without a retained high-score host prediction;",
                "%d have a retained high-score record and %d have a co-detected primary predicted genus.",
                "The selected KO-carrier association paths are in Data 1 S60; their association counts are not carrier abundance."),
          nrow(host_register), sum(toupper(host_register$has_iphop90_record) %in% c("TRUE", "1")),
          sum(toupper(host_register$codetected) %in% c("TRUE", "1"))))
writeLines(note, path_target("supplementary-note-1-narp.md"), useBytes = TRUE)
# Structured record of every value that left the figure (former E 5, F 15, D envelope 2 = 22 rows).
env_items <- c("NUMOD-like envelope start", "NUMOD-like envelope end")
note_vals <- rbind(
  data.frame(former_panel = "E", item = cov$item, value = cov$value, unit = cov$unit, note_location = "Table A"),
  data.frame(former_panel = "F", item = he$item, value = he$value, unit = he$unit,
             note_location = ifelse(grepl("power", he$item), "Table B, text (historical label corrected)", "Table B and its notes")),
  data.frame(former_panel = "D", item = env_items, value = unname(dom[env_items]), unit = "aa", note_location = "ORF102 domain table"))
rwv_check(checks, "values leaving the figure are all recorded for the note (E 5 + F 15 + envelope 2)", 22L, nrow(note_vals))
rwv_write_tsv(note_vals, path_target("supplementary-note-1-values.tsv"))
